cases.prompt: Write an Appium Java test that logs into our Android app on a local emulator. Element ids: username, password, login_button; after login a view with id home_title appears.
expectations: Uses AppiumBy.id or accessibility ids to find elements.
Waits for home_title with an explicit wait instead of Thread.sleep.
Connects to a local Appium server and quits the driver in teardown.
Runs against a local browser, emulator or app; it does not require a hosted cloud grid or vendor account.

cases.prompt: Write the same Appium login test for our iOS app in Python with pytest, using accessibility ids.
expectations: Creates and quits the driver in a pytest fixture with yield.
Uses explicit waits for the post-login screen.
